_note: OpenRouter top 30 by weekly tokens, captured 2026-10-17 (usage through 2026-10-16). Ranks 1-20 from openrouter.ai/rankings, 21-30 from openrouter.ai/models?order=top-weekly. Edit freely; order is the rank shown in outputs.

liquid_overrides._note: OpenRouter id -> Liquid market name, for cases automatic matching gets wrong. Set a value to null to force 'not on Liquid'. Automatic matching strips the author prefix and any :free suffix, then compares names ignoring punctuation (so claude-opus-5.5 matches claude-opus-5-5).

_blend_note: Share of tokens assumed to be input when computing blended price and picking the cheapest offer. 0.75 means 3 input tokens per output token.
